exact.潮还没推: The tide has not pushed yet
exact.标只在潮推完之后、你还站着的那一格算数。海胆也要等潮推完才算。: A mark counts only on the cell where you still stand after the push. An urchin counts only after the push too.
exact.一次被冲比省下两只锚更贵。下锚可以压住脚下的海胆。: One sweep costs more than two saved anchors. An anchor braces the urchin under you.
exact.把下一步潮往哪边、标和海胆在被推之后落在哪一格写进你自己的 memory。只把这: Write which way the next tide pushes, and which cell a mark or urchin lands on after the push, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
exact.先走，潮再推。下锚压住海胆。: Step, then the tide. An anchor braces an urchin.

patterns.zh: 先向{0}，潮再向{1}。潮会把你顶在墙上。
patterns.en: Step {0}, then the tide goes {1}. It pins you to the wall.

patterns.zh: 先向{0}，潮再把你推到 {1},{2}。那一格是还没踩的标。
patterns.en: Step {0}, then the tide pushes you to {1},{2}. That cell is an open mark.

patterns.zh: 先向{0}，潮再把你推到 {1},{2}。那一格没有标。
patterns.en: Step {0}, then the tide pushes you to {1},{2}. That cell has no mark.
Step {0}, then the tide pushes you to {1},{2}.

patterns.zh: 先向{0}，潮再把你推到 {1},{2} 的海胆上。
patterns.en: Step {0}, then the tide pushes you onto the urchin at {1},{2}.

patterns.zh: {0},{1} 海胆。潮推上去算一次被冲，下锚可以压住。
patterns.en: Urchin at {0},{1}. Landing there after the push is a sweep. An anchor braces it.

patterns.zh: 下锚压住海胆，停在 {0},{1}。锚还剩 {2}。
patterns.en: Anchor and brace the urchin at {0},{1}. Anchors left {2}.
Anchored and braced the urchin. Held {0},{1}.
The tide pushed you onto an urchin. Sweeps {0}.

patterns.zh: 本局踩了 {0} 个标，被冲 {1} 次。
patterns.en: This run stood {0} marks and was swept {1} times.
